title: Frequent parades
content: Idk why I never really thought about it until now but I almost always have some sort of parade going on in my dreams. Usually on the street of where I’m living, or at my amusement park. I guess my mallworld is very celebratory lol. I’m almost never able to enjoy it though. I usually feel like I have to run through it to get to something on the other side or inconvenienced by it. I also never really noticed what exactly they’re celebrating. Anyone else??
